application.description: Minimal reference application for common/mcap_replayer: replays the topics of an mcap_logger_reference recording -- two isaac.JointStateCpu waveforms, an isaac.PoseCpu/TwistCpu/TransformCpu circular motion, an isaac.CameraInfoCpu, a tensor-schema holoscan.schema.Image counter stream, and the same counter recorded as hardware-encoded video when the host can decode it -- into a live graph at their recorded timing, and prints a replay summary on exit.

replay.description: Replay a recording written by mcap_logger_reference. Pass --input-path=<file>; add --visualize to show the counter image streams in windows.

application.name: mcap_replay_reference
